newsitem.title: USA: Madame Chiang Kai-shek celebrates 100th birthday.
newsitem.headline: Madame Chiang Kai-shek celebrates 100th birthday.

text.p: Madame Chiang Kai-shek, once the most powerful woman in China as the wife of Nationalist leader Chiang Kai-Shek, quietly celebrated her 100th birthday on Thursday at a party at her Manhattan apartment attended by her closest relatives, a spokesman said.
The spokesman said that between 20 and 30 relatives, including nieces, nephews, grandchildren and great grandchildren, attended the party.
Madame Chiang has lived in New York on and off since her husband died in 1975 in Taiwan, where he and his followers fled when Mao Tsetung's Communist army took power on the Chinese mainland in 1949.
Generalissimo Chiang died without realising his goal of reclaiming power in China and was succeeded in Taiwan by Madame Chiang's stepson, Chiang Ching-Kuo, who died in January 1988.
A delegation of visiting Taiwanese political figures who saw Madame Chiang earlier in the week said she appeared to be in good health and good spirits.
